paite: Huan Siria kumpipa Ben-hadad in asepaih tengteng akaikhawm vek a, kumpipa sawmthum-le-nih atel ua, sakol leh kangtalaite toh akuantou a, Samaria khua ava um a, adouta hi.
heading: Siria Toh Kidouna
english: Ben Hadad the king of Syria gathered all his army together; and there were thirty-two kings with him, with horses and chariots. He went up and besieged Samaria, and fought against it.

paite: Israel kumpipa Ahab kiang ah khopi sung ah mi asawl a, akiang ah, Ben-hadad in hichi in achi,
english: He sent messengers into the city to Ahab king of Israel and said to him, “Ben Hadad says,

paite: "Na dangka leh dangka-eng kei a ahi. Na zite leh na tate, na neih hoihpente tan in leng kei a ahi," achi hi.
english: ‘Your silver and your gold are mine. Your wives also and your children, even the best, are mine.’”

paite: Israel kumpipa'n ana dawng a, "Ka toupa, kumpipa aw, na gen bang in kei leh ka neih tengteng nang a ahi," achi hi.
english: The king of Israel answered, “It is according to your saying, my lord, O king. I am yours, and all that I have.”

paite: Amisawlte apai nawn ua, Ben-hadad in hichi in achi, "Ka kiang a na dangka leh dangka-eng, na zite leh na tate na hon piak ding ahi, chi in mi hon sawl ding ka hi,
english: The messengers came again and said, “Ben Hadad says, ‘I sent indeed to you, saying, “You shall deliver me your silver, your gold, your wives, and your children;

paite: 'Zingchiang hiai hun in ka sikhate na kiang ah ka hon sawl dia, na inn leh na sikhate inn ahong mai ding uh.' Huan hichi ahi ding a, na mit late ala ding ua, ahon paipih vek ding uh," achi hi.
english: but I will send my servants to you tomorrow about this time, and they will search your house and the houses of your servants. Whatever is pleasant in your eyes, they will put it in their hand, and take it away.”’”

paite: Israel kumpipa'n agam a upa tengteng asam a, thei un, “Hiai mi in thil hoih loutak hih atupdan. Ka kiang ah mi ahon sawl a, ka zite, ka tate, ka dangka leh ka dangka-eng ahong ngen a, amah ka na nial kei hi," achi hi.
english: Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land, and said, “Please notice how this man seeks mischief; for he sent to me for my wives, and for my children, and for my silver, and for my gold; and I didn’t deny him.”

paite: Upa tengteng leh mipi tengteng in akiang ah, "Amah na limsak dah inla, angette leng pe sam ke'n," achi uhi.
english: All the elders and all the people said to him, “Don’t listen, and don’t consent.”

paite: Ben-hadad misawlte kiang ah, "Kumpipa, ka toupa kiang ah, na sikha kiang a mi sawl a na hon nget masak tengteng bang in ka hih dia; himahleh hiai zaw ka hih kei ding," achi, chỉ un. Huchi in amisawlte apai nawn ua, huai thu ava tun uhi.
english: Therefore he said to the messengers of Ben Hadad, “Tell my lord the king, ‘All that you sent for to your servant at the first I will do, but this thing I cannot do.’” The messengers departed and brought him back the message.

paite: Ben-hadad in akiang ah mi asawl nawn a, "Kei hon zui teng in akhut dim ua apham dia kiching Samaria kho leivui nutsiat ahihleh pathiante'n alohloh hon loh uhenla, huai sang a sezaw in leng," achi hi.
english: Ben Hadad sent to him, and said, “The gods do so to me, and more also, if the dust of Samaria will be enough for handfuls for all the people who follow me.”

paite: Israel kumpipa'n adawng a, "Mi kigalthuam khinsa, agalvan suah khesa bang in ki-uangsak kei hen, chi in va hilh un,” achi hi.
english: The king of Israel answered, “Tell him, ‘Don’t let him who puts on his armor brag like he who takes it off.’”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, amah leh kumpipate'n puanin a zu ana dawnkhawm lai un huai thu Ben-hadad in ana za a, amite kiang ah, "Kisa dih ua," achi hi. Huchi in khua dou ding in akisata uhi.
english: When Ben Hadad heard this message as he was drinking, he and the kings in the pavilions, he said to his servants, “Prepare to attack!” So they prepared to attack the city.

paite: Huchi in ngai in, zawlnei khat in Israel kumpipa Ahab ava naih a, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Hiai mipi tampite na mu hia? Ngai in, tu in na khut ah ka hon pe ding. Huchi in kei TOUPA ka hi, chih na thei ding uh," achi hi.
english: Behold, a prophet came near to Ahab king of Israel, and said, “Yahweh says, ‘Have you seen all this great multitude? Behold, I will deliver it into your hand today. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.’”

paite: Ahab in, "Kua zang in eita?" achi hi. Ama'n, "TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Gam sehkhente a heutu tangvalte zang in," achi hi. Ama'n, “Kua'n dou dia thu pe ding eita?” achi hi. Ama'n, "Nangmah in,” chi in adawng hi.
english: Ahab said, “By whom?” He said, “Yahweh says, ‘By the young men of the princes of the provinces.’” Then he said, “Who shall begin the battle?” He answered, “You.”

paite: Huchi in ama'n gam sehkhente a heutu tangvalte akaikhawm a, zanih sawmthum-le-nih ahi uh. Huai mite nung in mi tengteng, Israel suan tengteng akaikhawm a, sangsagih ahi uh.
english: Then he mustered the young men of the princes of the provinces, and they were two hundred and thirty-two. After them, he mustered all the people, even all the children of Israel, being seven thousand.

paite: Sun laitak in ava pawt ua, Ben-hadad leh kumpipate, amah panpih kumpipa sawmthum-le-nihte huai puanin ah zu dawnkham in ana om uh.
english: They went out at noon. But Ben Hadad was drinking himself drunk in the pavilions, he and the kings, the thirty-two kings who helped him.

paite: Gam sehkhente a heutu tangvalte ava pawt masa ua; Ben-hadad in mi asawl a, "Amau, Samaria a pan hong pawt a-om uh," chi in ahilh uh.
english: The young men of the princes of the provinces went out first; and Ben Hadad sent out, and they told him, saying, “Men are coming out from Samaria.”

paite: Ama'n, "Kilep tum a hong ahih uleh hingmat unla, kidou tum a hong ahih uleh leng hingmat un," achi hi.
english: He said, “If they have come out for peace, take them alive; or if they have come out for war, take them alive.”

paite: Huchi in hiai gam sehkhente a heutu tangvalte leh ahon zui sepaihte khua a pan apawt uhi.
english: So these went out of the city, the young men of the princes of the provinces, and the army which followed them.

paite: Abitum chiat uh ava that ua; huchi in Siriate ataikekta ua, Israelte'n adelh uhi. Huchi in Siria kumpipa Ben-hadad sakol tung a tuang in sakol tungtuang mite toh asuakta hi.
english: They each killed his man. The Syrians fled, and Israel pursued them. Ben Hadad the king of Syria escaped on a horse with horsemen.

paite: Israel kumpipa ava pawtkhia a, sakol leh kangtalaite ava sual a, Siriate tampi athat hi.
english: The king of Israel went out and struck the horses and chariots, and killed the Syrians with a great slaughter.

paite: Zawlnei in Israel kumpipa ava naih a, akiang ah, "Kihatsak inla, na hihdan ding ngaihtuah in kum hong beileh Siria kumpipa'n hong dou nawn ding ahi," achi hi.
english: The prophet came near to the king of Israel and said to him, “Go, strengthen yourself, and plan what you must do, for at the return of the year, the king of Syria will come up against you.”

paite: Siria kumpipa sikhate'n akiang ah, "Apathiante uh mualte pathiante ahi uh. Huaiziak a ei sang a amau hatzaw ahi uh. Phaizang ah dou lehang, amau sang ini hatzaw ngeingei ding uh," achi uhi.
heading: Siria Hong Dou Nihveina
english: The servants of the king of Syria said to him, “Their god is a god of the hills; therefore they were stronger than we. But let’s fight against them in the plain, and surely we will be stronger than they.

paite: "Hiai thilhih in, kumpipate avek un lakhia inla, amun uah gamuk mite koih in.
english: Do this thing: take the kings away, every man out of his place, and put captains in their place.

paite: Sepaihte, sakolte leh kangtalaite, na mansuahsa zah geih sepaihte ding khethaksak nawn in. Huchi in phaizang ah i dou ding ua, amau sang in i hatzaw na ding uhi,” achi uh. Ama'n athugen uh angaikhia a, huchibang in ahihta hi.
english: Muster an army like the army that you have lost, horse for horse and chariot for chariot. We will fight against them in the plain, and surely we will be stronger than they are.” He listened to their voice and did so.

paite: Akum nawn in hichi ahong hi a, Ben-hadad in Siriate akaikhawm a, Israelte dou ding in Aphek ah ahohtou hi.
english: At the return of the year, Ben Hadad mustered the Syrians and went up to Aphek to fight against Israel.

paite: Israel suante leng akikaikhawm ua, nek ding asekkhawm masa ua, dou ding in akisata uhi. Israel suante kelnou tawm chikchik hon nih bang lel in ava kilang ua; Siriate bel gam ah apumdim uhi.
english: The children of Israel were mustered and given provisions, and went against them. The children of Israel encamped before them like two little flocks of young goats, but the Syrians filled the country.

paite: Pathian mipa'n Israel kumpipa va naih in, ahoupih a, akiang ah, "TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Siriate'n, TOUPA mualte Pathian ahi a, phaizang Pathian ahi kei, achi uhi. Huaiziak in hiai mipi tampite na khut ah ka hon pe ding hi, huchi in kei TOUPA ka hi, chih na thei ding uh," achi hi.
english: A man of God came near and spoke to the king of Israel, and said, “Yahweh says, ‘Because the Syrians have said, “Yahweh is a god of the hills, but he is not a god of the valleys,” therefore I will deliver all this great multitude into your hand, and you shall know that I am Yahweh.’”

paite: Ni sagih sungtak akinangtuah nilouh uh. Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani sagih ni in akidouta ua; Israel suante'n Siria mite ni khat in sepaih nuaikhat athat uhi.
english: They encamped opposite each other for seven days. Then on the seventh day the battle was joined; and the children of Israel killed one hundred thousand footmen of the Syrians in one day.

paite: Midangte bel Aphek ah, khopi sung ah atailut ua, omlaite mi singnih-le-sangsagih kulh chim in achipkhumta hi. Ben-hadad atai a, khopi sung ah dantan sunggil ah alut hi.
english: But the rest fled to Aphek, into the city; and the wall fell on twenty-seven thousand men who were left. Ben Hadad fled and came into the city, into an inner room.

paite: Asikhate'n akiang ah, "Ngai in, Israel inkuan lak a kumpipate mihehpih thei kumpipate ahi uh chih thu ka za uh. Sai-ip puan teng in, ka lu ua khau a kikhih in Israel kumpipa kiang ah hon va hohsak in; ama'n ahon hinghawi nuam khamoh kei ding," achi uhi.
english: His servants said to him, “See now, we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful kings. Please let us put sackcloth on our bodies and ropes on our heads, and go out to the king of Israel. Maybe he will save your life.”

paite: Huchi in sai-ip puan ateng ua, alu uah khau in akikhih ua, Israel kumpipa kiang ah ava hoh ua, "Na sikha Ben-hadad in, hehpih in hon hinghawi hen, achi," achi uhi. Ama'n, "Dam lai ahi maw? Amah ka unaupa ahi," achi hi.
english: So they put sackcloth on their bodies and ropes on their heads, and came to the king of Israel, and said, “Your servant Ben Hadad says, ‘Please let me live.’” He said, “Is he still alive? He is my brother.”

paite: Huai mite'n lungnuamtak in, alungsim thutak gen ahi ding chih gingta in, "Na unaupa Ben-hadad himah e," achi pah uhi. Huchi in ama'n, "Va pai unla, hon pi un," achi hi. Ben-hadad ahong pawtkhia a, akiang ah ahoh a; ama'n akangtalai ah ana tuangsak hi.
english: Now the men observed diligently and hurried to take this phrase; and they said, “Your brother Ben Hadad.” Then he said, “Go, bring him.” Then Ben Hadad came out to him; and he caused him to come up into the chariot.

paite: Ben-hadad in akiang ah, “Ka pa'n na pa a pan khua ana lakte ka hon pekik ding. Ka pa'n Samaria a sumsinna munte a bawl bang in Damaskas ah sumsinna munte na bawl sam ding hi. Huchibang a thu kikhung in ka hon paisak ding hi," achi hi. Huchi in akiang ah thu akhung a, apaisakta hi.
english: Ben Hadad said to him, “The cities which my father took from your father I will restore. You shall make streets for yourself in Damascus, as my father made in Samaria.” “I”, said Ahab, “will let you go with this covenant.” So he made a covenant with him and let him go.

paite: Zawlnei tapate lak a mi khat in TOUPA thu in alawmpa kiang ah, "Hon khen in," achi a; huai mi in akhen ut kei hi.
heading: Zawlnei In Ahab Amohpaih
english: A certain man of the sons of the prophets said to his fellow by Yahweh’s word, “Please strike me!” The man refused to strike him.

paite: Huchi in akiang ah, "TOUPA thu na man louh ziak in, ngai in, mual na hon khupsantak in, humpinelkai in ahon na kei ding," achi hi. Mual akhuptak in humpinelkai in atuak a, athat hi.
english: Then he said to him, “Because you have not obeyed Yahweh’s voice, behold, as soon as you have departed from me, a lion will kill you.” As soon as he had departed from him, a lion found him and killed him.

paite: Huchi in midang ava mu nawn a, "Hon khen in," achi a; huai mi in akhen a, aliamta hi.
english: Then he found another man, and said, “Please strike me.” The man struck him and wounded him.

paite: Huchi in zawlnei apai a, lampi ah kumpipa ana tang a, amai a vut nuh in ana kibawl lamdang hi.
english: So the prophet departed and waited for the king by the way, and disguised himself with his headband over his eyes.

paite: Kumpipa ahong tun in kumpipa ana sam a, "Kei na sikha kidouna lak ah ka tailut a; ngai in, mi khat ahong kilehhei a, ka kiang ah mi khat ahon pi a, hiai mi na veng in, ataimangleh ahinna sik in na hinna na tan dia, ahihkeileh dangka talent khat na piak ding ahi," achi hi.
english: As the king passed by, he cried to the king, and he said, “Your servant went out into the middle of the battle; and behold, a man came over and brought a man to me, and said, ‘Guard this man! If by any means he is missing, then your life shall be for his life, or else you shall pay a talent of silver.’

paite: "Kei na sikha ka pumbuai ziak in ana paimangta hi," achi hi. Israel kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Huchibang geih in na tung a thu khen ahi ding, nangmah in thu khen khin na hi ve," achi hi.
english: As your servant was busy here and there, he was gone.” The king of Israel said to him, “So shall your judgment be. You yourself have decided it.”

paite: Ama'n amai a pan vut alakhezok a; Israel kumpipa'n zawlneite lak a mi ahi chih atheita hi.
english: He hurried, and took the headband away from his eyes; and the king of Israel recognized that he was one of the prophets.

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Hihsiatgawp dia ka sehsa mi khat na paisak ziak in ahinna sik in nang hinna, amite sik in na mite na tan ding," achi hi.
english: He said to him, “Yahweh says, ‘Because you have let go out of your hand the man whom I had devoted to destruction, therefore your life will take the place of his life, and your people take the place of his people.’”

paite: Israel kumpipa bel nguitak leh lungkim loutak in apai a, Samaria khua ahong tungta hi.
english: The king of Israel went to his house sullen and angry, and came to Samaria.
